01
Instant Indoor
Self-assembling indoor furniture powered by Westfield's folding expertise
Instant Indoor

Indoor Furniture That Sets Up in Minutes

  • 33"×33" modular base derived from Canine Canyon Ayla Dog Cot platform — proven X-brace scissor fold
  • Foam-wrapped U-tube back/arms insert into modified corner plastics — tool-free 10–15 min assembly, 300 lb capacity
  • Sofa variants: bench seat (continuous seat + 3 back cushions) and standard cushion (3+3) — both with polyfill-lined slipcover
  • Expandable system — single chair → loveseat → sofa → L-shaped sectional via variable U-tube configs
$18.6B Flat-pack market (2024)
$600–$2.5K Target price range
4–20% Annual growth
Strategic Advantage
Non-seasonal revenue stream on proven outdoor steel tube platform. Fabric: Texstyle "Louis" bouclé — 100% SDP, 62,000 cycle abrasion, Off White & Kit colorways. No one has combined outdoor-grade folding with indoor aesthetics.

Origami Wagon
A single-sheet polymer wagon body using living hinge technology
Origami Wagon

One Sheet. No Fabric. Folds to a Briefcase.

  • Single polymer sheet with living hinges replaces tube + fabric construction
  • Flat-folds into briefcase form — dramatically smaller than quad-fold wagons
  • Structure is the basket — no separate frame needed
  • Deploys elegantly, stores more compactly than any wagon on market
$1.42B Folding wagon market
$500M North America
0 Direct competitors
Category Creation Opportunity
No existing product uses living-hinge origami for a wagon body. First mover creates the category.
Origami Wagon — Development Update
Development Status

Current Card Signal
  • ▸June 23 update says the full-size hand-formed sample is promising.
  • ▸Factory is trying different materials, scoring methods, heating, and pressing into a mold.
  • ▸Project remains A-priority and active on HF R&D.
Development Read
  • ▸The core question has moved from sketch concept to material/process proof.
  • ▸Process documentation is now as important as the object: lay-up, forming method, fold creation, heat, pressure, and any scoring process.
  • ▸If the sample holds up, this can define a new wagon body architecture rather than another tube/fabric variant.
Risks & Open Questions
  • ▸Living-hinge fatigue and full-scale load durability are still unproven.

  • ▸Indianapolis review needs the physical sample, not just photos.
Next Milestones
  • ▸Ship the 1:1 hand-formed sample to Indianapolis.
  • ▸Document material, lay-up, forming, hinge/fold creation, and process variables.
  • ▸Use sample review to decide whether to proceed into engineered prototype development.

Systems Wagon
Modular transport platform built on the milk-crate ecosystem with M-LOK mounting
Systems Wagon

One Platform. Infinite Configurations.

  • 24-quart milk crate ecosystem — 28″W × 40″L fits 4 crates in 2×2 grid
  • M-LOK mounting system for tool-free accessory attachment
  • Razors-and-blades model — base chassis + high-margin accessories
  • Range Pro Kit — gun inserts, ammo trays, brass bags for shooting sports
$180–$250 Base chassis
50–70% Accessory margins
$450–$750 Customer LTV
NOT a Folding Wagon
Competes with them, but purpose-built for organized utility. Rigidity is the feature, not a trade-off.

Motion That Sells Itself on the Floor

05
GRAM Chair
Compliant mechanism rocking — lightweight parallelogram motion on a director's chair platform
SKW · GRAM Chair

Director's Chair Meets Compliant Mechanism

  • Built on a standard director's chair frame — proven, cost-effective platform
  • Elastomeric corner joints (shown in red) replace rigid hardware at all four corners
  • Under weight shift, corners flex — frame transitions from square to parallelogram
  • The geometry change itself creates the rocking arc
  • No runners, springs, or linkages — just material flex
  • Each corner joint = pivot + spring + stop in one component
The Name
GRAM — dual reference to lightweight construction (lighter than any existing rocking solution) and the parallelogram motion.
GRAM Chair — Development Update
